methods.name: update
methods.summary: Updates the fallback origin configuration for custom hostnames on a zone.
methods.description:
Updates the fallback origin configuration for custom hostnames on a zone. Sets
the default origin server for custom hostname traffic.

props.name: zone_id
props.description: Identifier.

props.name: origin
props.description:
Your origin hostname that requests to your custom hostnames will be
sent to.

methods.summary: Removes the fallback origin configuration for custom hostnames on a zone.
methods.description:
Removes the fallback origin configuration for custom hostnames on a zone. Custom
hostnames without specific origins will no longer have a fallback.

props.name: zone_id
props.description: Identifier.

methods.description:
Retrieves the current fallback origin configuration for custom hostnames on a
zone. The fallback origin handles traffic when specific custom hostname origins
are unavailable.

props.name: zone_id
props.description: Identifier.

methods.name: update
methods.summary: Replace a single custom certificate within a certificate pack that contains two bundled certificates.
methods.description:
Replace a single custom certificate within a certificate pack that contains two
bundled certificates. The replacement must adhere to the following constraints.
You can only replace an RSA certificate with another RSA certificate or an ECDSA
certificate with another ECDSA certificate.

props.name: zone_id
props.description: Identifier.

props.name: custom_hostname_id
props.description: Identifier.

props.name: certificate_pack_id
props.description: Identifier.

props.description: If a custom uploaded certificate is used.

props.name: custom_key
props.description: The key for a custom uploaded certificate.

methods.name: delete
methods.summary: Delete a single custom certificate from a certificate pack that contains two bundled certificates.
methods.description:
Delete a single custom certificate from a certificate pack that contains two
bundled certificates. Deletion is subject to the following constraints. You
cannot delete a certificate if it is the only remaining certificate in the pack.
At least one certificate must remain in the pack.

props.name: zone_id
props.description: Identifier.

props.description: Identifier.

props.name: certificate_pack_id
props.description: Identifier.

methods.name: get
methods.summary: Returns custom hostname quota usage for a zone.
methods.description:
Returns custom hostname quota usage for a zone. The allocated quota is a soft
limit; creating custom hostnames after usage exceeds this limit can still
succeed until the hard cap is reached. Use the exceeded and hard_cap fields to
track when usage is above the soft limit and when new custom hostname creation
will be rejected.

props.name: zone_id
props.description: Identifier.

methods.name: create
methods.summary: Add a new custom hostname and request that an SSL certificate be issued for it.
methods.description:
Add a new custom hostname and request that an SSL certificate be issued for it.
One of three validation methods—http, txt, email—should be used, with 'http'
recommended if the CNAME is already in place (or will be soon). Specifying
'email' will send an email to the WHOIS contacts on file for the base domain
plus hostmaster, postmaster, webmaster, admin, administrator. If http is used
and the domain is not already pointing to the Managed CNAME host, the PATCH
method must be used once it is (to complete validation). Enable bundling of
certificates using the custom_cert_bundle field. The bundling process requires
the following condition One certificate in the bundle must use an RSA, and the
other must use an ECDSA.

props.name: zone_id
props.description: Identifier.

props.name: hostname
props.description: The custom hostname that will point to your hostname via CNAME.

props.name: custom_metadata
props.description:
Unique key/value metadata for this hostname. These are per-hostname
(customer) settings.

props.name: custom_origin_server
props.description:
a valid hostname that’s been added to your DNS zone as an A, AAAA,
or CNAME record.

props.name: custom_origin_sni
props.description:
A hostname that will be sent to your custom origin server as SNI for
TLS handshake. This can be a valid subdomain of the zone or custom origin server
name or the string ':request_host_header:' which will cause the host header in
the request to be used as SNI. Not configurable with default/fallback origin
server.

props.name: ssl
bundle_method
props.description:
A ubiquitous bundle has the highest probability of being verified everywhere,
even by clients using outdated or unusual trust stores. An optimal bundle uses
the shortest chain and newest intermediates. And the force bundle verifies the
chain, but does not otherwise modify it.

props.name: certificate_authority
props.description: The Certificate Authority that will issue the certificate.

props.name: cloudflare_branding
props.description:
Whether or not to add Cloudflare Branding for the order. This will add a
subdomain of sni.cloudflaressl.com as the Common Name if set to true.

props.name: custom_cert_bundle
props.description: Array of custom certificate and key pairs (1 or 2 pairs allowed).

props.name: custom_certificate
props.description: If a custom uploaded certificate is used.

props.name: custom_csr_id
props.description: The identifier for the Custom CSR that was used.

props.name: custom_key
props.description: The key for a custom uploaded certificate.

props.name: method
props.description: Domain control validation (DCV) method used for this hostname.

props.name: settings
ciphers
props.description:
An allowlist of ciphers for TLS termination. These ciphers must be in the
BoringSSL format.

props.name: early_hints
props.description: Whether or not Early Hints is enabled.

props.name: http2
props.description: Whether or not HTTP2 is enabled.

props.name: min_tls_version
props.description: The minimum TLS version supported.

props.name: tls_1_3
props.description: Whether or not TLS 1.3 is enabled.
SSL specific settings.

props.name: type
props.description:
Level of validation to be used for this hostname. Domain validation (dv) must be
used.

props.name: wildcard
props.description: Indicates whether the certificate covers a wildcard.
SSL properties used when creating the custom hostname.

methods.name: list
methods.summary: List, search, sort, and filter all of your custom hostnames.
methods.description: List, search, sort, and filter all of your custom hostnames.

props.name: zone_id
props.description: Identifier.

props.name: id
props.description:
Hostname ID to match against. This ID was generated and returned
during the initial custom_hostname creation. This parameter cannot be used with
the 'hostname', 'hostname.exact', 'hostname.contain', or 'hostname.startsWith'
parameters.

props.name: certificate_authority
props.description:
Filter by the certificate authority that issued the SSL
certificate.

props.name: custom_origin_server
props.description: Filter by custom origin server name.

props.name: direction
props.description: Direction to order hostnames.

props.name: contain
props.description:
Filters hostnames by a substring match on the hostname value. This parameter
cannot be used with the 'id', 'hostname', 'hostname.exact', or
'hostname.startsWith' parameters.

props.name: exact
props.description:
Fully qualified domain name to match against. This parameter cannot be used with
the 'id', 'hostname', 'hostname.contain', or 'hostname.startsWith' parameters.

props.name: startsWith
props.description:
Filters hostnames by a prefix match on the hostname value. This parameter cannot
be used with the 'id', 'hostname', 'hostname.exact', or 'hostname.contain'
parameters.

props.name: hostname_status
props.description: Filter by the hostname's activation status.

props.name: order
props.description: Field to order hostnames by.

props.name: ssl
props.description: Whether to filter hostnames based on if they have SSL enabled.

props.name: ssl_status
props.description: Filter by SSL certificate status.

props.name: wildcard
props.description: Filter by whether the custom hostname is a wildcard hostname.

methods.name: edit
methods.summary: Modify SSL configuration for a custom hostname.
methods.description:
Modify SSL configuration for a custom hostname. When sent with SSL config that
matches existing config, used to indicate that hostname should pass domain
control validation (DCV). Can also be used to change validation type, e.g., from
'http' to 'email'. Bundle an existing certificate with another certificate by
using the "custom_cert_bundle" field. The bundling process supports combining
certificates as long as the following condition is met. One certificate must use
the RSA algorithm, and the other must use the ECDSA algorithm.
